title: Linux Basics
subtitle: Start at the prompt
description: The command line, from zero. Learn how the shell actually works, how to move around a filesystem, and how to read the permissions and processes that everything else in Linux is built on.

lessons.title: What Is a Shell?
lessons.summary: What you're actually talking to when you open a terminal.

title: Shell Scripting
subtitle: From one-liners to something you can trust
description: Write shell scripts that survive contact with a real machine. Variables, quoting, exit status, loops, functions, and redirection — in portable POSIX sh, the shell that exists in every container and CI image.
